newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Suspected rebels kill family of six in Colombia.
newsitem.headline: Suspected rebels kill family of six in Colombia.

text.p: Suspected leftist guerrillas have killed a family of six in southern Colombia after a failed extortion attempt, police said on Friday.
A police spokesman blamed the Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia (FARC), the country's largest guerrilla army, for the attack on Thursday in the town of San Jose de Fragua, in Caqueta province.
The head of the family, a businessman, had received demands for money from the FARC, the spokesman said.
